scripts.test:contracts: npm run test:contract-core && npm run test:release-contracts
scripts.test:journeys: node --test test/coverage-acceptance.test.js test/human-audit.test.js test/prompt-adapters.test.js test/reference-journey.test.js test/report-destination.test.js test/system-file-picker.test.js
